bio: Everything revolves around the charcoal grill in this atmospheric establishment pleasantly situated in a quintessential old Dutch building. Whether he's barbecuing T-bone steak, a rack of lamb or sole, the chef bends the flames to his will with a sure touch. The results are dishes that are generous and brimming with typically robust flavours and character. The jovial owner will be happy to guide you through the menu, which also includes classics such as snails and onion soup – there are plenty of mouth-watering options....
